list: Official PS5 trophy list: 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze), 28 hidden until earned. Names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation Network via Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops automatically the moment you hold the other 54 trophies, so there is nothing extra to do beyond the rest of this guide. The long pole is A Long Road (100% completion) plus the big counters like 250 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Use the roadmap tab to work stage by stage, and keep this checklist ticked as you go so the last few trophies never surprise you. Expect roughly 200 hours all-in, in a single playthrough with no online trophies.
steps: Earn all 54 other trophies.
Work the roadmap stages in order: story, strangers, activities, collectibles, robberies and money.
Finish with A Long Road at 100% completion; the platinum follows.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase (GTA VI PS5 trophies) and PSNProfiles, cross-checked 18 Nov 2026. Platinum structure (all trophies in one playthrough, no online trophies): KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It cannot be missed: it is the first thing the game asks you to do, and it teaches the basics on the water before the story opens up. Just play through the intro and it unlocks on its own.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission Gone Fishing to the end.
The trophy unlocks automatically when the mission completes.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (hidden story trophy). Mission order: KeenGamer roadmap step 1; PlanetGTA6 trophy list.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 1. Unmissable as long as you keep playing the main missions. One warning for the chapter itself: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and accept her balcony meditation invite before Chapter 1 ends — that spot counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is the one interaction in the game currently flagged as potentially missable.
steps: Play the Chapter 1 main missions to the chapter's end.
Before finishing the chapter, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (needed for Positive Mental Attitude).
Keep a manual save at the chapter start in case you want to revisit anything.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Balcony meditation warning: KeenGamer roadmap step 1; Output Lag trophy list (missable note).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 2 — the asterisks are part of the official name as PlayStation publishes it. Unmissable. Chapter 2 is also where Jason and Lucia become a playable pair, which opens up the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy), so it is worth trying those once both characters are available.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 main missions to the end.
Once both Jason and Lucia are playable, consider the partner trophies while the story is still fresh.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (name printed with asterisks by the game itself). Partner availability: Output Lag trophy list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 3. Unmissable — keep following the main mission markers and it unlocks when the chapter wraps. By now the map is wide open, so scan new vehicles and landmarks with the WAiNK app as you travel; those scans feed You WAiNKer! and Whip It Good later.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 main missions to the end.
WAiNK-scan unfamiliar vehicles and landmarks on the way to bank progress for later trophies.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. WAiNK habit: KeenGamer roadmap step 1.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Chapter 4. Unmissable. Chapter 4 also matters for cleanup: the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks the big bank vault jobs, which you will want for Maximum Withdrawal and for the 100% checklist, so do not rush past optional work in this chapter.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 main missions to the end.
Pick up the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… when it appears — it opens the bank vault robberies.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Vault unlock timing: KeenGamer 100% completion section.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for finishing the final mission. Unmissable, and the story leaves you in free roam afterwards, so nothing locks away when the credits roll. Keep a manual save before the finale anyway: the game has no mission replay, and a pre-finale save is cheap insurance for anything you want to redo.
steps: Save manually before starting the final mission.
Complete the final mission; free roam continues afterwards for cleanup.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. No mission replay / free roam after story: KeenGamer roadmap table; Output Lag trophy list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy tied to the named mission Breakfast Run. Like the other named-mission trophies it unlocks automatically when you finish that mission during the campaign — no side conditions, no medals needed. If you are following the main story you will get it without thinking about it.
steps: Reach and complete the story mission Breakfast Run.
No optional objectives are required for the trophy.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (hidden trophy). Story trophies unlock naturally: KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically at the end of that mission. Heists are also a good moment to learn the robbery systems, since the same skills feed Maximum Withdrawal and the other crime trophies later.
steps: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist.
Use it to learn robbery mechanics for later crime trophies.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Robbery systems feeding later trophies: PlanetGTA6 platinum overview.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Child's Play. Automatic and unmissable on a normal playthrough. There are no difficulty or medal requirements anywhere in this list, so play it however you like.
steps: Complete the story mission Child's Play.
The trophy unlocks on mission completion.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. No difficulty/medal trophies: KeenGamer roadmap table.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Headliners. Automatic and unmissable. If you ever wonder whether you have passed it, check this list: the named-mission trophies arrive in story order, so a ticked DWNFALL means Headliners is behind you.
steps: Complete the story mission Headliners.
The trophy unlocks on mission completion.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing VCIA Takedown. Automatic and unmissable. VCIA (the airport) comes back later for the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can, so it is worth learning the layout while you are here.
steps: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown.
Note the airport layout — you will return for Catch Me If You Can.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing Operation Savage Glory. Automatic and unmissable on the main path. As with every story trophy here, cheats are the only real hazard: turning one on disables trophies (and saving), so keep them off for the whole platinum run.
steps: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
Keep cheats off — they disable trophies while active.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Cheats disable trophies: PowerPyx via PlanetGTA6; KeenGamer roadmap table.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold trophy for reaching 100% completion, and the longest single grind in the list. The in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) is your source of truth: it wants the story, 100 optional tasks, set numbers of robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 8 bank vaults…), collectible quotas (100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos…), all 42 shooting-range golds, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges and more. You do not need literally everything in Leonida — hit each quota and move on.
steps: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the checklist line by line.
Prioritise quotas that double up with other trophies (WAiNK scans, shooting golds, stunts, robberies).
Skip anything past its quota — 100% needs selected portions, not every collectible.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. 100% checklist quotas: KeenGamer 100% completion section (robberies, collectibles, activities tables).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts are tracked by category in the Progress menu, and the 100% checklist asks for 300 of the 397 available, so this trophy lands on the way there. Do stunts whenever you pass a ramp or a marked jump instead of saving them all for cleanup — spread out, 250 is painless.
steps: Take every stunt jump you pass while travelling.
Check Progress for your stunt total and top up the easiest categories first.
Aim past 250 toward the 300 the 100% checklist wants.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Stunt totals (397 available, 300 for 100%): KeenGamer activities table.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. You do not need to win or finish anything — starting each activity once is enough. The activities unlock as the story introduces them (fishing, hunting, races, drone races, arcade games and so on), so sweep any activity marker you have not touched yet and this one resolves itself.
steps: Visit each activity type once as the story unlocks them.
Starting the activity counts; winning is not required.
Use the map filters to find activity types you have not tried.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Nine activity types: KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for earning a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is one of the few genuinely skill-based trophies, and the 100% checklist wants the same 42 golds, so there is no double work. Learn each range's layout, use Combat Focus where it helps, and retry freely — challenges can be re-attempted until you gold them.
steps: Visit every shooting range and clear each challenge.
Retry challenges until each one shows a gold medal (42 total).
Track your gold count in Progress so none slip through.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. 42 gold medals required for 100% too: KeenGamer activities table.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. The 100% checklist separately wants all 42 drone time trials completed across those locations, so while you are at each spot, run its time trials too and you will bank both. Drone handling rewards smooth lines over speed — ease off in tight sections.
steps: Find each Top Fun location and win its drone race (14 total).
Complete the drone time trials at the same locations for the 100% checklist (42 total).
Prioritise clean flying over raw speed in tight sections.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. 14 locations / 42 time trials: KeenGamer trophy table and activities table.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count, so keep moving to new events. The 100% checklist wants 30 of the 40 unique races won, so this trophy is a milestone on that road. A tuned car from your garages makes the later races much kinder.
steps: Enter races across Leonida and win 20 distinct events.
Keep going to 30 unique wins for the 100% checklist.
Upgrade a favourite car before tackling the harder circuits.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. 30 of 40 unique races for 100%: KeenGamer activities table.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is introduced early (Gone Fishing), and Cal's challenge is the competitive version of it. Learn the basic cast-and-reel rhythm first, then take the challenge when it appears — beating Cal once is all the trophy asks.
steps: Unlock fishing through the early story.
Accept Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him once.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Fishing introduction: KeenGamer trophy table (Gone Fishing).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. There are four video games to play for the 100% checklist, so finish each of them once while you are at it. Pick the game you find easiest, play it through to its end screen, and the trophy is yours.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet and play a game to completion.
Play all four video games once for the 100% checklist.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Four video games for 100%: KeenGamer activities table.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — the trophy lands on his final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore and meet people, and finishing five named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus three more also covers Strangers & Freaks. If a strand stalls, check the map for its next marker; some only advance after story progress.
steps: Meet Andy and work through his missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission to earn the trophy.
Count it toward the 8 strands Strangers & Freaks needs.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Named strands in roadmap step 3: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand. Kenton also ties into collectibles — five of his seven treasure sets are on the 100% checklist — so his strand is worth doing early and thoroughly. The trophy itself only needs his final mission completed.
steps: Work through Kenton's missions to his final one.
While you are at it, hunt his treasure sets (5 of 7 needed for 100%).
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Kenton's treasure sets quota: KeenGamer collectibles table.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand; the trophy unlocks on his final mission. Like the other named strands it counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Do strands as they unlock rather than saving them all for the end — a few only open after certain story beats, and spreading them out keeps the endgame short.
steps: Complete Billy's missions through to the final one.
Count the strand toward Strangers & Freaks (8 needed).
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Strands in roadmap step 3: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. The five named strands with their own trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count, so you need three more beyond those. Strangers appear as markers while you explore; finishing a strand means completing its final mission, not just meeting the person.
steps: Complete the five named strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone).
Finish any three additional stranger strands you find while exploring.
Track strand completions here — 8 total earns the silver.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Eight qualifying strands: KeenGamer trophy table and roadmap step 3.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand; the trophy lands on his final mission. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks like the other named strands. If Randy's next mission does not appear, advance the story a little and check the map again.
steps: Complete Randy's missions through to the final one.
Count the strand toward Strangers & Freaks (8 needed).
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Strands in roadmap step 3: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand; the trophy unlocks on his final mission. Together with Andy, Kenton, Billy and Randy, Tyrone completes the set of five named strands — after him you only need three more stranger strands for the Strangers & Freaks silver.
steps: Complete Tyrone's missions through to the final one.
With the five named strands done, find three more for Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Strands in roadmap step 3: KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy currently flagged as potentially missable: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1 (after Down to Earth, in the morning) counts as one of the spots and the moment passes when the chapter ends. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18, but the trophy wants every single one — so do the balcony spot early, keep a Chapter 1 save, and sweep the rest during cleanup.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house.
Keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until the trophy is earned.
Meditate at the remaining spots across Leonida (18 total).
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. 18 spots and the missable balcony moment: KeenGamer trophy table, roadmap step 1 and collectibles table; Output Lag missable note.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt one unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting work runs through his Target Decks — the 100% checklist wants all 15 of them finished — but this trophy only needs a single unique-animal hunt completed for him. Pick up his strand when it appears, track the marked animal, and bring it down cleanly.
steps: Meet Bret and accept a unique-animal hunt from his Target Deck.
Track and hunt the marked animal to complete the job.
Finish all 15 Target Decks later for the 100% checklist.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Bret's 15 Target Decks: KeenGamer activities table and roadmap step 2.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida as a classic collectible hunt, and the 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets — so this silver is an early milestone, not the end. Grab every card you pass, check which sets are closest to complete in the collection menu, and finish those first.
steps: Pick up collectible cards whenever you spot them while exploring.
Check the collection menu for near-complete sets and hunt their missing cards.
Complete 3 sets for the trophy; push to 15 sets for 100%.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. 15 of 18 card sets for 100%: KeenGamer collectibles table.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for using the WAiNK app at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game phone app for scanning places and things around Leonida; the 100% checklist wants the same 100 scans. The trick is habit: scan every landmark, viewpoint and oddity you pass from Chapter 1 onward, and the hundred arrives almost for free.
steps: Open WAiNK and scan locations, landmarks and points of interest as you travel.
Start in Chapter 1 — early scans save hours of cleanup.
Track your scan count toward 100.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. 100 WAiNK locations for 100%: KeenGamer collectibles table; WAiNK habit in roadmap step 1.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the bite-size objective list tracked in Progress — there are 80 in total and the 100% checklist asks for 70 of them, so pick the 50 you find easiest for this trophy and leave the nastiest ten alone even for 100%. Many complete themselves while you do other trophies.
steps: Open the Challenges list in Progress and pick off the easy ones first.
Complete 50 for the trophy.
Push to 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist, skipping the ten hardest.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. 70 of 80 challenges for 100%: KeenGamer activities table and roadmap step 2.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build up a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it completely. Both Jason and Lucia need to be together, so this opens once the pair are playable together in Chapter 2. Get the heat up with crimes in a busy area, then break line of sight, swap vehicles if you can, and stay hidden until the stars clear.
steps: Have Jason and Lucia together (available from Chapter 2).
Commit crimes until the Wanted Level reaches 4 stars.
Break line of sight, change vehicles, and hide until the heat fully clears.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Partner availability from Chapter 2: Output Lag trophy list.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping your Wanted Level alive the whole time — if the stars fully clear between shops, the chain breaks. Pick three shops close together, rob the first, move fast to the second and third, and stir up a little trouble on the way if the heat starts fading. Escape properly only after the third till is empty.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops near each other.
Rob shop one, then move straight to shop two and three without letting the Wanted Level clear.
Escape the heat after the third robbery.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Partner requirement: Output Lag trophy list.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK is the reliable way to register them, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base-model vehicles discovered out of 277 — so scan every new model you see from the start. Car meets, dealerships and busy parking areas are goldmines for quick discoveries.
steps: WAiNK-scan every unfamiliar vehicle model you pass.
Sweep car parks and dealerships for clusters of new models.
Reach 100 for the trophy; keep going to 200 base models for 100%.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. 200 of 277 base-model vehicles for 100%: KeenGamer collectibles table.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus, the slow-motion combat ability. Set it up where enemies cluster — a gang operation or a robbery gone loud is ideal. Position so several targets are in view, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them before it ends. If you fall short, any busy firefight gives you another try.
steps: Find a fight with at least five enemies in reach (gang operations work well).
Activate Combat Focus with targets grouped in view.
Down five enemies before the ability ends.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Combat Focus single-use requirement: KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, steal a departing passenger aircraft at Vice City International Airport and take off in it. Head to the airport in free roam, get to a plane that is preparing to depart, take control, and get airborne. Expect a Wanted Level; the trophy is about the departure, so get wheels-up and away.
steps: Go to VCIA in free roam and find a passenger aircraft preparing to depart.
Take control of the plane and take off.
Fly clear of the airport to complete the unscheduled departure.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (hidden trophy). Method (steal a departing aircraft at VCIA): KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the Rhino, the game's military tank: steal one and use it in combat. Rhinos show up with heavy military response, so the usual route is to cause enough chaos to draw one out — or find one parked at a military site — then take it and turn its cannon on your pursuers. Save first; this one gets messy.
steps: Draw out a military response or locate a Rhino at a military site.
Steal the tank and use it in combat.
Keep a manual save before the attempt.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (hidden trophy). Method (steal a Rhino and use it in combat): KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected. This is the stealth counterpart to the loud robberies: get in, take the goods, and get out without triggering an alarm or a Wanted Level. Scout the store first, move when staff are looking away, and leave quietly. Jewelry you fence also counts toward the $100,000 jewelry quota on the 100% checklist.
steps: Scout a jewelry store and watch staff movement.
Rob it without being detected — no alarm, no Wanted Level.
Fence the jewelry toward the 100% checklist quota.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Jewelry fenced quota ($100,000): KeenGamer robberies table.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for robbing five bank vaults and escaping each time. The big vault jobs unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… during Chapter 4, and the 100% checklist wants all eight vaults — so do every vault you find and the silver lands on the way. A failed escape does not count: plan your getaway vehicle and route before you go in.
steps: Unlock vault jobs via That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4.
Rob a vault and escape cleanly — repeat for five vaults.
Clear all eight vaults for the 100% checklist.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Vault unlock and 8-of-8 quota: KeenGamer robberies table and 100% section.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol Leonida's roads; block or ram one to stop it, deal with the crew, take the cash, and lose the heat. One successful job is all the trophy needs, and the cash helps the money trophies.
steps: Spot an armored truck on the road and stop it.
Rob the truck and take the cash.
Escape the Wanted Level to bank the trophy.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Robbery set overview: PlanetGTA6 platinum overview.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — uncover the full map. Travel every region, including the far corners and offshore areas, until no fog remains. A plane or helicopter tour is the fastest way to fill the gaps, and the trip doubles as a WAiNK-scanning and vehicle-spotting run. Check the map for any grey patches you have missed.
steps: Travel through every region of Leonida, including offshore areas.
Use aircraft to sweep remote corners quickly.
Check the map for remaining fog and visit those spots.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Full-map requirement: KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of Leonida's nine gangs. Gang operations are also a 100% checklist line (39 of 39), so you will be clearing them anyway — the trophy just needs the spread across all nine gangs rather than repeats of the same one. Track which gangs you have hit; the last few are usually the ones whose turf you rarely visit.
steps: Rob illegal operations as you find them, noting each gang.
Make sure all nine gangs are covered at least once.
Clear all 39 gang operations for the 100% checklist.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Nine gangs and 39 operations quota: KeenGamer trophy table and robberies table.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is one of the cryptic hidden trophies whose exact trigger is still being confirmed by the community at launch. The description points to ordering or drinking a cocktail at an Ocean Beach spot with a view — try beach bars and rooftop spots along Ocean Beach, and watch this space: we will pin the exact trigger here once a source confirms it.
steps: Head to Ocean Beach and try its bars and viewpoint spots.
Order/enjoy a cocktail at a spot overlooking the beach.
Exact trigger still being confirmed — check back for updates.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (hidden trophy). Trigger unconfirmed at launch: KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out, the old-school way. The exact showroom and trigger are still being confirmed at launch, but the shape of it is clear: get into a dealership showroom car and exit through the window rather than the door. Save before you try; showrooms remember.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with cars on display.
Get in a display car and drive out through the showroom glass.
Exact trigger still being confirmed — check back for updates.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (hidden trophy). Method unconfirmed at launch: KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: steal the three key valuables inside the bowling alley and escape. Treat it like a small heist — get in, grab all three valuables, and get out. One clean run earns the trophy.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Steal the three key valuables inside.
Escape to complete the job.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (hidden trophy). Method (three key valuables, escape): KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — in practice, max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Strength grows through physical activity: melee fights, sports and gym-style exertion. Work on both characters, not just your favourite, and check the stats screen to see who is lagging.
steps: Raise Jason's Strength through physical activities and fights.
Do the same for Lucia until her Strength is maxed.
Check both stat screens to confirm.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (hidden trophy). Method (max Strength for both characters): KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse: perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Almost everything shady you do in free roam — robberies, thefts, fights, escapes — feeds the profile, so this is a slow background counter rather than a single stunt. Play the crime side of the game naturally and it fills; check Progress to see your count.
steps: Do criminal-profile actions in free roam: robberies, thefts, fights, escapes.
Check Progress for your running count toward 500.
It fills naturally alongside the robbery trophies.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (hidden trophy). 500 criminal-profile actions: KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. This hidden trophy's unlock method was still unconfirmed at launch — the description hints at succeeding at something on a second attempt after a first failure. We will not invent a method: when a source confirms the trigger, it will be written here. Until then, if it pops during your run, note what you just did twice.
steps: Method unconfirmed at launch — no verified steps yet.
The description suggests a second-attempt success; check back for the confirmed trigger.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (hidden trophy). Unlock method unconfirmed: KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — a hidden trophy whose method is still unconfirmed at launch. The title and description point at one of Leonida's strange encounters or easter eggs. Rather than guess, this guide leaves it marked unconfirmed until a source pins it down; exploring odd locations while you clear The Goodtime State is the best bet in the meantime.
steps: Method unconfirmed at launch — no verified steps yet.
Explore Leonida's odd corners while working on The Goodtime State.
Check back for the confirmed trigger.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (hidden trophy). Unlock method unconfirmed: KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: hit enemies with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle, bowling-style. The precise count and setup are still being confirmed at launch. The working approach: equip a melee weapon, ride as passenger or lean from a vehicle at speed, and strike targets as you pass. We will tighten the exact requirement here once a source confirms it.
steps: Equip a melee weapon and get into a moving vehicle.
Strike enemies with melee drive-by hits as you pass.
Exact requirement still being confirmed — check back for updates.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles (hidden trophy). Precise method unconfirmed: KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; your contacts convert them to clean money at their cut. The 100% checklist wants the same $250,000 fenced, so this is not double work. Fence regularly instead of hoarding bills, and watch the total climb in Progress.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts until the cumulative total reaches $250,000.
Track the fenced total in Progress.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. $250,000 Marked Bills quota: KeenGamer robberies table.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, car parts and property-adjacent purchases all add up, and by the endgame you will be rich from robberies — so if the counter is short, a shopping spree across Leonida's stores closes it quickly. Track the spend total here as you go.
steps: Spend money in shops throughout the game — every purchase counts.
If short near the end, go on a deliberate shopping run to pass $100,000.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Cumulative shop spend: KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties. Garages double as safe storage for your best cars (handy for races), so they are worth buying as soon as you can afford them. Robbery income covers the prices comfortably by mid-game; buy each garage as it becomes available and tick them off here.
steps: Buy each garage property as it becomes available (8 total).
Fund purchases with robbery and laundering income.
Store tuned race cars in them for Earn Cash, Not Kudos.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Eight garage properties: KeenGamer trophy table.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Once the app is available on your phone, register vehicles you own or acquire — ten registrations earn the trophy. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good: vehicles you discover and keep can be registered as you go.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app once it is available.
Register vehicles until you reach 10.
Register newly discovered vehicles alongside Whip It Good progress.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase and PSNProfiles. Ten registrations: KeenGamer trophy table.
